title: A video that isn't the step gets the same kind pushback as a mismatched photo
origin: Issue #163 (More ways to send proof): Should, a video or document that isn't the step is handled like a mismatched photo

history.text: Day 3 tonight, Maya. Ten pages of Atomic Habits at 8, then a quick voice note saying what you read.

plan.proof_note: a quick voice note saying what you read
plan.reason: Ten pages a night finishes the book this month.

testerLines: [video kitten.mov: A grey kitten chasing a laser dot across a wooden floor for about 20 seconds. No book, no reading, nobody speaks.] done!!

testerLines.say: lol wrong video. [voice: Ten pages done, chapter four, the two-minute rule: make the habit so small you can't say no.]
testerLines.when: after ZOH says the video doesn't show the reading and asks for the voice note

whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: a video can be the wrong thing, like a photo.
shouldHaveHappened: The kitten video doesn't show reading: ZOH enjoys it lightly but doesn't count it, and asks for the voice note about the pages, kindly and without suspicion. The voice note names the pages and the two-minute rule: ZOH counts it and reacts to that, without inventing anything.
